title: Correct tube length
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 41 cm.

title: Correct final temperature
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 312 K.

title: Pressure equilibrium setup
description: Important: Student must apply force equilibrium to find gas pressures (78 cmHg and 74 cmHg) before and after inversion.

title: Gas volume expressions
description: Important: Student must correctly express gas volumes in terms of tube length L, mercury height, and distances.

title: Application of gas law
description: Important: For part (2), student must apply Gay-Lussac's law (or combined gas law) relating initial and final states of the heated gas.

title: Consistent unit usage
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent pressure units (cmHg) and length units (cm) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign when calculating gas pressure after inversion (e.g., adding instead of subtracting ρgh).

title: Volume misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misidentifying the gas column length, especially after inversion, by confusing the position of mercury surfaces.
